scenario: LUNI.8.4 — division of two dimensioned values is ambiguous; rejects with DS_VALIDATE_DIM_AMBIGUOUS. `r.dist / r.elapsed_s` (length / time-as-float) where both are dimensioned errors. Pin: even same-dim division (a dimensionless ratio) requires explicit Float(...) strip per LUNI.8.4 — the spec example `let ratio: Float = Float(r.a) / Float(r.b)`.
rules_ds:
schema Pair scope logical:
    a: meter key
    b: meter mutable

rule ratio:
    Pair p where (p.a / p.b) > 1
->
    log info "a wider than b"
